remainingDebt.detail: Public user-facing JSON REST door (@Controller("cart")). FALSE-POSITIVE CANDIDATE: the example app exposes no GraphQL surface at all, so 'a plain JSON read belongs in the GraphQL schema' has no referent here; none of the four sanctioned reasons (probe, external webhook, bytes, machine/operator identity) can honestly apply. Documented in-file as intentional REST-only design.

dist/ staleness is a runtime footgun: E2EStackService.ensureBuilt() only builds when main.js is missing, so a stale dist silently serves old code (old wire codes, old routes). npm run build before test:e2e is required after source changes.

Emulated dist keeps @modules/@features specifiers verbatim (tsc does not rewrite paths, no tsc-alias in build); spawned api children resolve them via TS_NODE_BASEURL=dist set in spawnApi env - without it the children crash on MODULE_NOT_FOUND. If package.json ever gains tsc-alias (out of scope today), that env becomes redundant but harmless.
